android.architecture: Universal; uses installed Android System WebView
android.distribution: Signed release APK; offline assets included; no network permission

ios.continuation: Implementation, MP3 conversion, Chromium/mobile emulation, unit/build/Android checks continue locally. No proxy bypass or disabled TLS verification used.
ios.remaining: Allow these hostnames to perform the missing WebKit/hosted-site checks. Real iPhone/iPad QA and native Apple signing remain separate requirements.

limits: Chromium iPhone emulation is not Safari/WebKit or physical iOS certification.
